title: Man-in-the-middle compromise of a Modicon M340 engineering session

attacker_profile.description: An external attacker with access to a compromised supplier engineering workstation and the ability to position themselves on the controller communication path.

entry_point.description: A temporarily connected supplier engineering workstation used to configure and maintain the Modicon M340 PLC.

target.description: A critical process controller running firmware SV3.70 and controlling the cooling-water circulation pump.

attack_path.name: Initial Access
attack_path.description: The attacker gains control of the supplier engineering workstation or obtains access to its active engineering environment.
required_conditions: The supplier engineering workstation is available to the attacker or has been compromised.
The workstation is connected during the maintenance operational state.

attack_path.name: Access to the Engineering Network
attack_path.description: Using the compromised engineering workstation, the attacker gains access to the industrial network path used for communication with the Modicon M340 PLC.
required_conditions: The engineering workstation is connected to the industrial switch.
The controller communication path is reachable from the engineering workstation.

attack_path.name: Position on the Communication Path
attack_path.description: The attacker positions themselves on the communication path between the engineering workstation and the Modicon M340 PLC.
required_conditions: The attacker can observe and modify traffic between the engineering workstation and the PLC.
The PLC is reachable through the active industrial network path.

attack_path.name: Intercept Valid Engineering Session
attack_path.description: A valid engineering user establishes a communication session with the Modicon M340 PLC while the attacker remains positioned on the communication path.
required_conditions: A valid user initiates an engineering communication session.
The attacker remains in a man-in-the-middle position during session establishment.

attack_path.name: Compromise of Controller Communication
attack_path.description: The attacker exploits an applicable weakness in the controller communication to compromise the confidentiality or integrity of the engineering session and potentially affect controller availability.
required_conditions: The deployed Modicon M340 CPU version is affected by the applicable vulnerability.
The attacker is positioned between the controller and engineering workstation.
A valid user is establishing the communication session.

attack_path.name: Impact on the Physical Process
attack_path.description: Loss of controller availability or integrity may interrupt or degrade reliable automated control of the cooling-water circulation pump.
required_conditions: The compromised controller communication affects controller availability or integrity.
The PLC's control function influences operation of the cooling-water circulation pump.
Existing process protection or recovery controls do not prevent the resulting operational effect.

global_preconditions: The system is operating in the maintenance state.
The supplier engineering workstation is connected to the industrial network.
The industrial switch provides a communication path to the Modicon M340 PLC.
The Modicon M340 PLC is running firmware SV3.70.
A valid engineering user establishes a communication session with the PLC.
The attacker can position themselves on the communication path between the engineering workstation and PLC.
Applicable vulnerabilities are identified during the vulnerability lookup stage.
assumptions: This is a synthetic test scenario.
The attack path is not evidence that the complete chain has been observed in a real deployment.
The Modicon M340 CPU belongs to the affected BMXP34 product range.
Firmware SV3.70 is installed for deterministic vulnerability-applicability testing.
Vulnerability identifiers and scores are maintained separately from the system component model.
A vulnerability may only enable an attack step when all of its technical prerequisites are satisfied.
The cooling-water circulation pump is a synthetic downstream physical-process asset controlled by the PLC.
